outcome: Surgical treatment of lumbar disc herniation
Surgical treatment of lumbar spinal stenosis
cohort: 1202 women aged ≥ 45 years who underwent operative treatment of lumbar degenerative disc disease and 1168 women without lumbar disease
finding: BMI, genetic history of lumbar disease, number of deliveries, simple hysterectomy, hypertriglyceridemia, and hyper-low-density lipoprotein cholesterolemia were independent risk factors for surgical treatment of both LDH and LSS in middle-aged and older women.
mod_finding: Number of deliveries was a risk factor for both lumbar disc herniation and lumbar spinal stenosis.
